document_chapter_status: CR065a is structured as Section 'Paul Revere Letter Implementation Specification' for the 30-50 page technical document.  CR065a_paul_revere_protocol.md is the draft protocol writeup; CR065a_hardware_spec.json is the hardware sheet.

review_scope: NV physical parameters (ZFS, Zeeman split, transition frequencies)
Microwave pulse sequence for Stage 3 envelope loading
Effective gate rate for T2_grav comparison
Citation accuracy for partner candidate groups
Subtraction of NV-specific decoherence channels (13C bath, surface, charge state)
expert_review_status.reviewer_input_protocol: Sean is in contact with a qubit-engineering domain expert.  All [EXPERT_REVIEW_REQUIRED] tags require confirmation, refinement, or refutation before promoting from PROVISIONAL_DRAFT to SEALED.

falsification_conditions: (F1) The (4/17, 9/17, 4/17) distribution NOT recovered within statistics across N >= 10000 runs.
(F2) Pre-commit boundary-stress reading shows no statistically significant signal (NV PL implementation may not realize the SAM sensor concept).
(F3) Effective T2 during Stage 4 CLEARLY exceeds T2_grav_at_A_0 by more than 10x after non-gravitational channel subtraction.

control_channels.envelope_loading: Composite pulse sequence preparing (1/4, 9/16, 1/4) population distribution
control_channels.microwave_drive: ~2.87 GHz +/- field offset, addresses |0> <-> |+1> and |+1> <-> |-1> transitions
control_channels.optical_initialization: 532 nm laser, ~us pulse, polarizes NV to ms = 0
control_channels.optical_readout: 637 nm excitation; PL counting at 637 nm distinguishes ms=0 (bright) vs ms=+/-1 (dim)

experimental_partner_candidates: Hanson group, Delft University of Technology [VERIFY_PRECOMMIT]

cryogenic_plus_dynamical_decoupling.ratio_T2_grav: AT THE LIMIT (~1.02x SAM floor per CR064a)
cryogenic_plus_dynamical_decoupling.use_case: Maximum-coherence verification of the SAM floor itself

immutability: Pairing recommendation, hardware spec, and protocol writeup are frozen at CR065a seal time.  Expert review may identify refinements requiring an appeal CR within 12a; the original v1.0 is preserved for the audit record.

implementation_recommendation.winner_rationale: 3 native sublevels (ms = 0/+1/-1); PL = direct photon-counting sensor; cryo+DD T2 ~ 1s AT SAM floor; room-temp accessible to many academic groups; mass-scale mapping open but slot-ratio testable

physical_quantum_state_normalization.Note: The 17/16 sum's structural significance vs the unit-normalized physical state is the open conceptual question; addressed in CR066a candidate.
physical_quantum_state_normalization.SAM_slot_weights_summing_to_17_16: (1/4, 9/16, 1/4) reflect SURFACE DEBIT fractions per CR129b

protocol_stages.name: Initial state preparation
protocol_stages.summary: Optical pumping 532 nm; polarize to ms=0 (CARRIER); pre-commit state

protocol_stages.name: Envelope loading
protocol_stages.summary: Tailored second pulse to (4/17, 9/17, 4/17) distribution; 9/8 surcharge = letter content

protocol_stages.name: Boundary stress reading
protocol_stages.summary: Optical 637 nm + PL count; sensor slot probability = stress signal

protocol_stages.name: Commit (measurement)
protocol_stages.summary: Projective measurement; row resolves; S_debit registers as 0.0615% of M_native

selection_criteria.T2_headroom: Margin between current T2 and T2_grav_at_A_0; 3 = comfortably below, 1 = at the limit
selection_criteria.mass_scale_match: Does platform's natural energy scale plausibly correspond to candidate's M_native scale? (1 = mapping open, 3 = natural fit)
selection_criteria.practical_accessibility: Can a partner group realistically access and operate this hardware? (0=exotic, 3=multiple academic and industry groups)
selection_criteria.sensor_cleanliness: Is readout a direct boundary-stress reader (vs indirect inference)? (0=indirect only, 3=direct photon/event counting)
selection_criteria.slot_count_match: Does platform provide 3 distinguishable physical levels for carrier/envelope/sensor? (0=no, 3=native 3-level structure)
